name: mathacademy_timeback
what: mathacademy_timeback serves Math Academy's own record of Alpha's students, matched to Timeback, behind the reader's Timeback token: the course Math Academy runs each student in, progress, XP remaining, grade and letter grade, estimated SAT score and completion flag (refreshed nightly); every task since 2025-07-01 with Math Academy's type, topic, course, XP awarded, questions and three clocks (elapsed, engaged, productive); Math Academy's course episodes and a nightly course history; the knowledge map on request; and, beside all of it, Timeback's seats, sections, flags and grades so the two halves can be compared. The reader never calls Math Academy. It answers, numbered to match ENABLEMENT § Capabilities: (1) a student's task history; (2) daily and weekly totals with the pace and habits measures (minutes to earn 1 XP against Math Academy's one-focused-minute calibration, 0.9 to 1.1 the good zone for lesson-heavy work; share of lessons with negative XP = rushing and guessing; share with zero XP = failed, kept apart); (3) the current course and how far through it, with whether the Timeback seat agrees; (4) who is active and who has gone quiet in a Timeback course, with an ordered reason per quiet student; (5) who has finished, by Math Academy's own completed flag and the nightly history, with Timeback's rounded 100 for the older half; (6) where a student is struggling, by Math Academy topic, with recovery; (7) whether a Timeback course is the one Math Academy runs, per student and per course; (8) estate-wide activity per day; (9) a student's whole Math Academy story as course episodes beside Timeback's seats; (10) cohort counts and roster hygiene; (11) engaged versus productive time; (12) the knowledge map. Timeback's own containers (results, line items, EduBridge) are Part B of the enablement: for today before tonight's pull, for which Timeback course an event was filed under, and for readers without store access.
when: Reach for mathacademy_timeback for any question about Math Academy students: what a student did and how (tasks, XP, minutes, focus, habits), where they are in their course and how much is left, who finished and who is quiet, where a student is struggling and what they know, whether the Timeback course record matches Math Academy's, and the estate or a course as a whole. Read the store first (how.store; ENABLEMENT Part A); every response carries snapshotAt and stale. Read Timeback's containers (how.native; ENABLEMENT Part B) for the roster half, for today before tonight's pull, and for which Timeback course an event was filed under. Route away to the Math Academy API only for what is fresher than last night (ENABLEMENT § One-off exact figures: a per-student fallback outside this skill's wire, never a polling path), and to timeback_production (https://timeback-loops-k8.vercel.app/dss/timeback_production/skill) or timeback_analytics (https://platform.timeback.com/mcps/analytics/skill) for the whole learning record across apps, MAP and mastery, screen-capture minutes and waste. The headline trap: the Timeback course an event is filed under is the enrollment the platform matched at ingestion, often a since-deleted one, sometimes a course the student never held, and never Math Academy's own course; the store's courseAgreement is the check (DICTIONARY traps 10 and 21; ENABLEMENT A7, A9, B7).

why.relevance: Math Academy is the core mathematics app for Alpha students in grades 4 to 12, and its events are the largest single external activity stream Timeback holds for math. The raw rows do not explain themselves: the task type hides in a URL, waste is always zero, reviews revisit earlier courses, titles are not canonical, and completion percent lives in three places (results, enrollments, the store). This skill supplies the genesis of every field, the named traps, and worked recipes, so a cold agent can answer without being silently wrong and without spamming the Math Academy API.
why.note: sha256 pins the exact bytes served at GET https://data-source-skills.vercel.app/contract on the day this front was built; version echoes that fetch's X-Doc-Version header. Re-pinned on every deploy.

store.what: Math Academy's own student records (Math Academy public API beta10), matched to Timeback students and served behind the reader's Timeback token: the primary source for every question about a student's work. Refreshed nightly at 03:00 America/Chicago (bulk list, four pages, plus one lookup per roster student still without a Math Academy record); at 03:45 the per-task activity (three clocks, Math Academy's course and topic per task) is pulled for every student who had a Math Academy result on each local day from the day before the last pulled day through yesterday (the overlap day is re-pulled for late rows; every student who ever held a seat is backfilled from 2025-07-01); every night's course figures are appended to a per-student history; the knowledge map is fetched live once on request and cached seven days; a student missing from the store is looked up live once when first asked for. Every response carries snapshotAt and stale.
store.status: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store  (snapshotAt, rosterReadAt, snapshotAgeHours, staleAfterDays, stale, schedule {nextSnapshotDueUtc, firstScheduledRunHasHappened, scheduledRunsSoFar}, history[] {at, source: schedule | schedule-test | manual}, activityLastDate, lastActivityRun, health, snapshotCalls, readCalls (estate-wide), routes, notes open to anyone; counts (with a nonTest block) and byCourse (each with a nonTest block) only when the request carries the reader's Timeback token, else countsGated true; no student values)
store.student: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}[?minimal=1]  or  GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student?email=<email>  (about one second each; two Timeback calls replayed; minimal=1 drops username, names, league and schedule)
store.activity: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}/activity?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD  (America/Chicago days; Math Academy's per-task timeElapsedMs / timeEngagedMs / timeProductiveMs, type, xp (nominal) and xpAwarded (= Timeback metadata.xp), course, topic, taskId; day totals in milliseconds with windowUtc; carries snapshotAt, stale, storeBegan, activityLastDate, daysRequested[] with a status per day, coverage {backfilledAt, backfilledFrom}, reasonIfEmpty; the first ask for a never-backfilled student pulls their whole Math Academy activity from 2025-07-01 once (about five calls) and serves it in the same response; Timeback's own activeSeconds is the ENGAGED clock)
store.courses: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}/courses  (the reader's token; Math Academy's own course episodes from the stored tasks since 2025-07-01: {sourcedId, snapshotAt, activityLastDate, coverage, currentCourse, episodes[] {mathAcademyCourseId, mathAcademyCourseName, firstTaskAt, lastTaskAt, lastLessonAt, firstDayChicago, lastDayChicago, tasks, lessons, xpAwarded, byType}, tasksTotal}; free for a backfilled student; ENABLEMENT A9)
store.history: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}/history  -> {sourcedId, snapshotAt, stale, storeBegan, nights, firstNight, lastNight, history: [{date, courseId, courseName, progress, xpRemaining, completed, startDate, grade, letterGrade, estimatedScore, deactivated, state, agreement, tbCourseIds}], note}  (one row per DATE since the store began on 2026-09-17, so today it holds a day or two; course changes and, where Math Academy set it before the move, the old course's completion date accumulate from here on)
store.knowledge: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/student/{user.sourcedId}/knowledge[?courseId=&refresh=1]  (one live Math Academy call on first ask, cached 7 days per courseId; response knowledge.courses[] has prerequisites FIRST and the requested course last, use knowledge.requestedCourse; stability 0 = no current evidence, untaught OR just failed; never loop it over a roster)
store.course: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/course/{course.sourcedId}  (the reader's token; one Timeback course's roster at snapshot time counted by courseAgreement, with testUsers, maNotStarted and a nonTest block whose byAgreement and byMathAcademyState include 'no math academy record' so every block sums to students)
store.courseStudents: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/course/{course.sourcedId}/students[?agreement=<value>]  (the reader's token; response {courseSourcedId, snapshotAt, stale, filter, count, nonTestCount, students (= count), rows[]}; each row {sourcedId, courseAgreementAtSnapshot, matchedBy, matchConfidence, isTestUser, isLikelyTest (the flag OR a synthetic naming pattern OR a test campus, judged in the store so readers never read names; use this one), classSourcedIds[], seatBeginDates[], currentSeatCount, grades[], unmatchedReason (unmatched rows), mathAcademyState, mathAcademyCourseId, mathAcademyCourseName, progress, xpRemaining, completed, startDate, estimatedScore, deactivated, figuresAsOf}; no names; an unknown agreement value is a 400 with the allowed list)
store.courseActivity: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/course/{course.sourcedId}/activity?date=YYYY-MM-DD  (the reader's token; day totals for every roster student with a store row who had a pulled America/Chicago day, milliseconds; carries rosterStudents, rosterNonTest, studentsWithStoreRow, rosterWithoutMathAcademyRecord, studentsWithActivity; 404 for an unknown course, 400 for a malformed date; the cohort form of ENABLEMENT A2)
store.finishers: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/finishers?since=YYYY-MM-DD[&mathAcademyCourseId=<id>]  (the reader's token; every store row, roster or not, whose CURRENT Math Academy course carries completed on or after since, or sits at progress >= 0.995; {since, snapshotAt, stale, count, nonTestCount, byBucket, rows[] {sourcedId, bucket (completed | at 100, not marked complete | left the roster near the end, not finished), mathAcademyCourseId, mathAcademyCourseName, completed, startDate, daysInCourse, progress, xpRemaining, mathAcademyState, courseAgreementAtSnapshot, timebackCourseSourcedIds[], offRosterSince, isLikelyTest, matchedBy, figuresAsOf}}; a student Math Academy has already moved to a new course is not here (ENABLEMENT A5, B6); free, loop-safe)
store.mathAcademyCourses: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store/courses  -> {snapshotAt, mathAcademyCourses: {<id>: <name>}, note}  (Math Academy course id -> name; the vocabulary of mathAcademyCourseId and currentCourse.id)
store.range: every student with a current in-window Math Academy seat at rosterReadAt, plus students added by a live lookup (a reader's first read, or the activity pull meeting a student with results but no id); a student who was on the roster at an earlier load and left it (progression moved them on, or the seat was deleted) KEEPS a row with their last-known Math Academy record, seats [], courseAgreementAtSnapshot 'no current timeback seat' and offRosterSince, refreshed by one direct Math Academy call on read once per 24 h, so their history and backfilled activity stay readable; a student never on the roster since the store began is 'not in snapshot' until read once (a live lookup adds them); finishers are listed by Math Academy's own flag at GET /store/finishers?since= (ENABLEMENT A5); a finisher Math Academy has already re-seated in a new course shows the new course on the row and is dated only by /history (from 2026-09-17, off-roster students from 2026-09-19) or by Timeback's rounded 100 (ENABLEMENT B6), so for a window that predates the store union A5 and B6
store.freshness: the store began 2026-09-17 with manual loads; the scheduler was proven the same day (history source schedule-test) and runs nightly from 2026-09-18; every response carries snapshotAt and stale (true past staleAfterDays, 2 as served, so a missed night shows the next day); per-student rows add figuresAsOf + figuresBasis; GET /store lists history (every load, with source), schedule (next due, whether the cron has fired) and lastActivityRun; a day can hold more than one snapshot, so pin each figure to the snapshotAt on its own response; past stale, quote Math Academy figures only with their date and take progress from Timeback's newest result (ENABLEMENT B4); a stuck refresh is a ticket on the feedback wire Three dates readers meet: nightly Math Academy records (rows, history) exist from 2026-09-17; nightly per-task activity days from 2026-09-15; backfilled activity for every student who ever held a seat from 2025-07-01; the read counters run from 2026-09-17T23:50Z.
store.gate: Authorization: Bearer <the reader's own Timeback token>. Student routes replay it against Timeback (GET users/{sourcedId}, GET enrollments) and serve the row only if Timeback answers 200 for that student under that token; a reader sees exactly the students its Timeback key can read. Counts (per course, and on /store) need a token Timeback accepts. Open without a token: the documents, /store freshness/schedule/health, /store/courses. The reader never holds a Math Academy key.
store.key: the Math Academy key is read at run time from one Secrets Manager secret by the nightly function and by the front (for the knowledge map and live lookups on a miss); it is never on the wire and readers never hold it
store.mathAcademyCallsAtReadTime: three cases, all counted under GET /store readCalls: (1) a per-student read of a student missing from the store makes one live lookup, once per 24 h per student (a nightly attempt counts as a try); (2) the knowledge route makes one live call per student per courseId per 7 days; (3) the FIRST /activity read of a student never backfilled pulls their whole Math Academy activity from 2025-07-01 (about five calls, once; coverage.backfilledAt then set). Nothing else reaches Math Academy at read time: /history, the course routes, /store/courses and every later read are free. Never loop the per-student route over a roster to find unmatched students: use /store/course/{id}/students?agreement=no math academy record.
store.fields: mathAcademy {id, username, firstName, lastName, created, deactivated, currentCourse {id, name, startDate, progress, xpRemaining, completed, grade, letterGrade, estimatedScore}, schedule, league} copied as Math Academy serves it (SAT Math Prep: progress null, estimatedScore set, xpRemaining UNRELIABLE there: 0 has been served for an active student and a figure for another; the state reads in progress whatever the truth); matchedBy (known | live-lookup | activity-lookup | backfill-lookup | username | email | lookup | name; counts.matchedBy on /store carries every bucket, the three lookup kinds normally 0 because a row added between loads by a lookup becomes `known` at the next load) + matchConfidence; figuresAsOf (ISO 8601 UTC, on every route the same field) + figuresBasis (a sentence: direct call vs bulk list); mathAcademyState (not started | in progress | at 100, not marked complete | completed | no math academy record); timeback.currentMathAcademySeats (live; flat seats {enrollmentSourcedId, courseSourcedId, courseName, classSourcedId, beginDate, endDate, pctCompleteApp}); courseAgreement (agree | agree, math academy course completed | disagree | disagree, math academy course completed | no current timeback seat | math academy has no current course | no math academy record | not in snapshot), a normalised name comparison plus Math Academy's completed flag, nothing more; DICTIONARY § The Math Academy snapshot store

native.purpose: Timeback's own containers: the roster half (seats, sections, flags, grades), today before tonight's pull, which Timeback course an event was filed under, and fallbacks for a reader without store access (ENABLEMENT Part B).
native.auth: Bearer <token>; the reader brings its own Timeback credential. Mint the token with an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials POST (grant_type=client_credentials; client id + secret as HTTP Basic, or as form fields) to https://prod-beyond-timeback-api-2-idp.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token; tokens expire after expires_in seconds (one hour as served). This front holds no key and proxies no data.
native.keyKind: a Timeback API client (OAuth 2.0 client id + secret on the Cognito pool above) with READ-ONLY scopes covering OneRoster rostering + gradebook reads and EduBridge analytics reads (the scopes named powerpath.readonly and analytics/v1p0/readOnly were sufficient for every call in ENABLEMENT.md). No write scope is needed and none should be granted.
native.keyContact: one client per person or agent, never shared: request it from the Timeback platform team (owner of api.alpha-1edtech.ai; tracker trilogy-group/timeback-platform). This skill issues no keys.
native.denied: a 401 on the token endpoint is a bad or expired client; a 403 or an empty result on a route that works for others is a scope or org limit of YOUR key, never an absence of data.

routes.results: GET /ims/oneroster/gradebook/v1p2/assessmentResults?filter=metadata.appName='Math Academy' AND scoreDate>='<utc instant>' AND scoreDate<='<utc instant>'&sort=scoreDate&orderBy=asc   (both bounds honoured; an America/Chicago day is 05:00Z..04:59:59Z in CDT)
routes.enrollments: GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/enrollments/?filter=user.sourcedId='<sid>' AND status='active'   (or filter=class.sourcedId='<cid>' AND status='active' for a section's roster; then keep role = student and the day inside beginDate..endDate, endDate being ABSENT when open: DICTIONARY trap 2)
routes.classes: GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/classes/?filter=course.sourcedId='<courseId>'   (every section of a course; title~'Math Academy' lists all Math Academy sections)
routes.courses: GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/courses/?filter=title~'Math Academy'   and GET .../courses/{id} for metadata.metrics.totalXp

how.explainer: https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/about  (a plain-words page for people: what the skill is, the nightly cycle, who can read what, live freshness; carries no student data)

courses.purpose: the domain of the course field: every OneRoster course titled Math Academy, with ids; a dated snapshot (readAt inside), regenerate with the call it names

courseXpSize.purpose: the XP-remaining rule list; reads the course's totalXp live, carries no figure

topicCourseMap.purpose: topic id -> majority filed course id, a dated heuristic snapshot for ENABLEMENT B8 (the weak Timeback-only suspect-course heuristic; the store's courseAgreement, A7, is the answer); regenerate rather than trust it

DICTIONARY.md.purpose: DICTIONARY.md carries what the OpenAPI cannot: the store's containers and fields first (Math Academy's record as this skill serves it, its genesis, range and traps), then how each Math Academy field inside Timeback is born, what its values mean, the containers and their range, the invariants and the numbered traps. Open it before trusting any field.

ENABLEMENT.md.purpose: ENABLEMENT.md puts the source to work, Math Academy first: twelve capabilities, a question-to-call catalog, eleven store recipes (Part A, exact routes, output shapes, failure modes) and nine Timeback recipes (Part B: the roster half, today, the filed-course view, and fallbacks for readers without store access). Open it when you need to act.

documents.note: sha256 + gitVersion pin the exact bytes served at each url on this deploy; the .md routes echo them as X-Doc-SHA256 / X-Doc-Version headers.

personBearingFields: assessmentResults metadata.studentEmail (other apps' rows in a student-filtered read)
pii.readRule: a reader may read and join on these inside its own session to answer the question it was asked; several arrive unasked (DICTIONARY trap 24: enrollment rows carry user.name, the class students route returns full user records, weekly facts rows carry email, other apps' results carry metadata.studentEmail), so scrub cached responses of those fields BY PATH (curriculum names such as knowledge.courses[].name, units[].name, topics[].name, courseName, topicName are not person-bearing and must stay), or use ?minimal=1 on the store; course and class TITLES on enrollment rows other than the 'Math Academy - …' titles in the reference file are treated as person-bearing (per-student custom courses carry the child's name) and are described by kind, never quoted
pii.publishRule: nothing that leaves the reader's session (report, dashboard, ticket, message, a file another process reads) carries a child's name, email, SIS number or login, or a row that identifies one child on its face; publish counts, classes, course ids, aggregates, or opaque user.sourcedId values to a recipient entitled to resolve them (a guide, a dashboard behind the school's login), never as a public artifact
pii.documents: every worked example in ENABLEMENT.md keys its output on user.sourcedId; DICTIONARY.md § Students are children states the rule and marks the fields
pii.testAccounts: Timeback's isTestUser flag misses whole batches of synthetic accounts; every store row and list row carries isLikelyTest (flag OR naming pattern OR test campus, judged server-side) and the nonTest counts use it; readers use that field and never inspect names
pii.servedValues: no served document or reference file of this skill contains any student value; the store routes serve one student's record only behind that reader's Timeback token, and /store serves counts only

feedback.covers: This lane covers this skill's two documents, its front, its reference files, and its store (a wrong match, a missed night, a missing student, a day of activity not pulled, a knowledge map that will not load). A defect in Timeback's APIs or data belongs to the Timeback platform (trilogy-group/timeback-platform); a defect in Math Academy's own product belongs to Math Academy. This wire does not relay third-party claims to either.
feedback.report: POST https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback with JSON {title, body, reporter, kind?} -> 201 {number, url}; no credential required
feedback.resolved: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback?state=closed  (or https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback/{number} for one ticket with its thread)
feedback.tracker: this skill's own tracker, served at GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback/{number}; every ticket is mirrored daily into a GitHub issue on trilogy-group/mathacademy-timeback-skill (labels skill-feedback + mathacademy_timeback) and closures on GitHub are copied back
feedback.note: Files an attributed ticket on the skill's own tracker and returns its number and URL at once; the ticket gains a githubUrl once the daily mirror runs. reporter is a free-text attribution and is required. kind is optional ('ask' | 'report'). Evidence in a ticket is a class, a field, a rule or a query; never a student's name, contact or identifying row.

provider.genesis: Written by an agent against the live Timeback wire on 2026-09-16, cross-checked against the Math Academy API during the build (one student's feed, the population's completion percent, task types on three students, XP remaining on ten), then corrected from the estate's registration panel and more than twenty independent cold runs on 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-17 (three rounds of three independent personas, each followed by a fix round); kept true by reader feedback.
